summary.headline: Dorotheus and Invisible Writing
summary.text: Astrological discussion of the Moon, Sun, ascendant, Jupiter, Mars, conjunctions, house rulers, and midheaven, quoting Dorotheus on planetary configurations and destructive outcomes. The page then gives recipes for making invisible white letters with gall, vinegar, water, and calamint, followed by Antiochus’s astrological interpretation of stars in the chart, beginning with the Moon on the hour.
